ui_bugs.issue: Scroll position restoration does NOT restore fully. Before navigation scrollY=23026 (105 items loaded). After clicking 'Ver más' → /noticias → browser back, sessionStorage cache 'pc_intelligent_feed_cache_v1' is present and items are restored (105 slots preserved), BUT window.scrollY only restored to 1310 (not close to 23026). Root cause: the 30ms setTimeout in useEffect fires before lazy-loaded images/DOM height stabilize, so window.scrollTo({top:cached.scrollY}) is clamped to the current maximum scrollHeight. Suggested fix: replace fixed 30ms timeout with a ResizeObserver / rAF retry loop that re-issues scrollTo until document.body.scrollHeight >= cached.scrollY (or a small retry counter with 100ms cadence up to ~2s).

issues: Group card cover area uses purple gradient fallback for all groups (no cover image). Functional fallback, but visually every card looks identical — consider generating a per-group hash-based gradient or emoji seed to differentiate.

rca_of_the_issue: Scroll-restore RCA: IntelligentFeed hydrates items from sessionStorage synchronously in useState initializer, and schedules window.scrollTo(cached.scrollY) after a fixed 30ms. However child FeedPostCard/PreviewCard images use loading='lazy' and content cards render progressively as React reconciles the 100+ node list. At t=30ms, document.body.scrollHeight is typically still <5000px while cached.scrollY is 23026 → browser clamps to max available (~1310). Fix must wait for layout: either ResizeObserver on the feed container until scrollHeight >= cached.scrollY, or a bounded rAF retry (max ~20 frames / ~2s) that re-invokes scrollTo. Alternative: pre-render lazy images as fixed-aspect placeholders so scrollHeight is deterministic even before image load.
